metadata.project_title: STRIDE-Based Threat Modelling of an AI Campus System
metadata.official_objective: Identify threats using STRIDE and recommend controls
metadata.modeling_methodology: STRIDE (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Denial of Service, Elevation of Privilege)
metadata.disclaimer: This is an academic threat-modeling project, NOT a real campus application. It uses a purely synthetic campus architecture and does NOT model the real Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering. No real student data, credentials, or live systems are used or attacked.

external_entities.name: Student
external_entities.description: Enrolled undergraduate or postgraduate student accessing academic services, schedules, attendance, and the campus AI assistant.

external_entities.name: Faculty
external_entities.description: Academic teaching and research staff posting grades, recording daily attendance, managing course modules, and advising students.

external_entities.name: Campus Administrator
external_entities.description: Privileged IT and academic office staff managing user provisioning, role assignments, system configurations, and security audits.

external_services.name: External Cloud AI/LLM Service
external_services.description: Third-party commercial generative AI API providing high-parameter foundational language model inference via HTTPS.

processes.name: Student Mobile/Web Application
processes.description: Client-side frontend rendering student dashboards, dispatching credentials, and submitting queries.

processes.name: Faculty Web Portal
processes.description: Web-based faculty management portal handling grade submissions, attendance rosters, and class communications.

processes.name: Administrator Portal
processes.description: High-privilege web console for campus configuration, identity lifecycle management, and security telemetry review.

processes.name: API Gateway
processes.description: Central campus ingress controller: terminates TLS, performs initial request validation, token verification, rate limiting, and route routing.

processes.name: Authentication and Authorization Service
processes.description: Identity provider verifying credentials, issuing signed tokens (JWT), evaluating RBAC permissions, and managing session state.

processes.name: Campus AI Assistant
processes.description: Conversational agent orchestrating campus query handling, prompt sanitization, RAG context assembly, and external LLM dispatch.

processes.name: Student Analytics Service
processes.description: Batch and stream processing engine computing student academic risk metrics, engagement trends, and GPA forecasts.

processes.name: Recommendation Service
processes.description: Machine-learning-based suggestion engine generating personalized elective options, remedial interventions, and academic resources.

data_stores.name: Student Information Database
data_stores.description: Student PII, residential addresses, contact numbers, guardian details, enrollment status, financial payment flags.

data_stores.name: Academic and Attendance Database
data_stores.description: Official course marks, GPA/CGPA calculations, semester transcript history, biometric attendance rosters.

data_stores.name: AI Conversation and Application Logs
data_stores.description: Historical user prompt dialogues, AI completion outputs, token usage statistics, session context tokens.

data_stores.name: Security Audit Logs
data_stores.description: Append-only security event trail: failed auth attempts, role escalations, administrative actions, and gateway access records.

trust_boundaries.name: Public/External User Zone
trust_boundaries.description: Separates unauthenticated end users (E1, E2, E3) and their personal client devices/browsers (P1, P2, P3) from the campus network. Carried over public untrusted internet and cellular networks.

trust_boundaries.name: Campus Application Zone
trust_boundaries.description: Encapsulates the private campus microservices subnet hosting P4, P5, P6, P7, and P8. Shielded behind reverse proxies and perimeter firewalls.

trust_boundaries.name: Protected Data Zone
trust_boundaries.description: High-security internal enclave containing persistence databases (D1–D4). Isolated via internal database firewalls, requiring mutual authentication and least-privilege service accounts.

trust_boundaries.name: External AI Service Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Demarcates the perimeter between the campus internal infrastructure (P6) and the third-party cloud provider (E4). Transits public WAN egress requiring rigorous egress data sanitization.

assumptions: 2. Users access the system through web/mobile interfaces.
3. The public internet is considered untrusted.
4. Campus backend services are trusted only within their defined security boundaries.
5. Databases contain sensitive synthetic student and academic information.
6. Authentication is handled by a dedicated authentication service.
7. Authorization is enforced by backend services.
8. Communication across untrusted networks should use encrypted channels.
9. The external cloud AI/LLM service is outside the campus trust boundary.
10. Security audit logs are intended to support accountability.
11. No real student information is used.
